recognize_zh: 這是PCR-RFLP的聚丙烯醯胺凝膠電泳：野生型VHL經Fnu4HI切割成187 bp與81 bp，而一個檢體只出現未切割的268 bp條帶，代表同型合子VHL c.598C>T（Chuvash polycythemia）。
features: Polyacrylamide gel with a DNA size marker lane (M) and seven sample lanes
One sample shows a single uncut 268 bp band, indicating loss of the Fnu4HI restriction site on both alleles (homozygous VHL c.598C>T)
Remaining samples show the digested 187 bp band with a faint 81 bp band, the wild-type pattern
No lane shows all three bands (268, 187, 81 bp), so no heterozygote is evident in this gel
Lane number labels appear offset relative to the lanes; interpretation follows the figure legend
describe_en: Polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis of a PCR-RFLP assay for the VHL c.598C>T variant is shown with a molecular size marker. Most sample lanes display the 187 bp and faint 81 bp fragments generated by Fnu4HI digestion of the wild-type 268 bp amplicon. One lane shows only the undigested 268 bp product, indicating homozygous loss of the restriction site. Heterozygotes would display all three bands, and none is evident here. Findings are consistent with homozygosity for VHL c.598C>T (p.Arg200Trp), the Chuvash polycythemia variant, in the index sample; note that lane labels appear misaligned with the lanes in this figure.

ddx.vs: Partial digestion would leave a 268 bp band together with 187/81 bp fragments in the same lane and would be flagged by a digestion control, whereas the homozygous lane shows the uncut band alone.
Carriers show all three bands (268, 187 and 81 bp) rather than a single 268 bp band.

ddx.dx: Other congenital erythrocytosis variants (EPOR, EGLN1, EPAS1)
ddx.vs: These are not detected by this Fnu4HI RFLP and require sequencing; their wild-type VHL pattern would be fully digested.
